scope: Complete historical-record derivative; no fresh model evaluation.

redaction_categories.internal_source_excerpt: Internal implementation excerpts or lineage prose were replaced with explicit redaction notices; no substitute dialogue was authored.
redaction_categories.identity_pseudonymization: Original job/trial identifiers were replaced with stable neutral pseudonyms.
redaction_categories.local_paths: Local usernames and host paths were replaced with stable neutral pseudonyms; portable task paths remain.
redaction_categories.container: Original container identifiers were replaced with neutral pseudonyms.
redaction_categories.network: Private endpoints and network topology were withheld.
redaction_categories.job_links: Native historical job URLs were replaced with archive-local references.
redaction_categories.historical_fingerprint: Original implementation and private package fingerprints were withheld; records are not repinned to the new evaluator.
redaction_categories.historical_version_label: Historical prompt labels use distinct neutral aliases, not the public evaluator version.
redaction_categories.historical_metric_rename: Legacy metric names were renamed to neutral dissei_ names without changing values.
redaction_categories.historical_key_rename: Private identifiers in JSON keys were replaced with deterministic neutral aliases; associated containers and numerical outcomes are retained.
redaction_categories.text_sanitization: Representations were decoded and sanitized consistently; terminal display escapes were normalized.

limitations: Redactions are visible omissions, not verbatim unmodified transcripts or invented dialogue.
The full evaluator, rubrics, judge prompts, and reference answers remain inspectable in the runnable package. Authoring IP protection is not an inference-proof guarantee.
Distinctive financial facts and third-party source notices remain; reidentification may be possible.
Historical no-op/reference-answer QA, recovery attempts, failures, and historical-baseline labels are not current model results.
Archive/header metadata is normalized. Historical event timestamps and all recorded numeric outcome scalars remain unchanged.
